definitions.explanation: A general term for any of several pure-white heron species found in Japan, including the great egret, intermediate egret, and little egret. Common around rivers, paddies, and coastal mudflats.

examples.japanese: ⟦{田|た}んぼ→田んぼ：00402_tanbo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{白鷺|しらさぎ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There's a white egret in the rice paddy.

examples.japanese: {白鷺|しらさぎ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{狙|ねら}っていた→狙う：00313_nerau⟧。
examples.english: A white egret was eyeing fish in the river.

examples.japanese: {姫路城|ひめじじょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{白|しろ}く→白い：00587_shiroi⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{白鷺城|はくろじょう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれている→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: Himeji Castle is also called the White Egret Castle because of its beautiful white appearance.

notes:
Not a single species but a cover term for white herons. Frequently appears in classical poetry and art as a symbol of grace and purity. Himeji Castle's nickname {白鷺城|はくろじょう} uses the same kanji read as ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧くろ.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{青鷺|あおさぎ}→青鷺：28732_aosagi⟧: grey heron — larger, blue-grey plumage
- サギ: heron (general) — covers both white and grey species
- ツル: crane — superficially similar but a different family
